clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Korran watches the Barrens for threats to the Horde. The Darkspear troll serves Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar and studies the silithid emerging across the scrublands.

At the Crossroads, Korran watches for threats beyond the quilboar and centaur clans. Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar stationed the troll scout there to observe changes in the land. Korran coordinates the gathering of intelligence for the Horde's leadership.

Korran now focuses on the Field of Giants in the southern Barrens. Strange, aggressive insectoid creatures called silithid have begun burrowing into the earth. To learn where the swarm came from and what danger it poses to the young Horde, Korran asks passing adventurers to dig up intact eggs with his claw tool.
